nodes.label: NAVIS Runtime Dependencies
nodes.rationale: Pinned to the exact versions the repo was developed and tested against on Python 3.12; generated from what is actually imported across extraction/, matching/, server/ and eval.py so the list stays evidence-based rather than aspirational.

nodes.label: python-multipart Invisible Runtime Dependency
nodes.rationale: FastAPI imports it at request time to parse multipart uploads on POST /ingest, so it never appears in an import grep; omitting it fails only at runtime, which is why it is pinned explicitly with a comment.

nodes.label: Dense Retrieval Degradation Fallback
nodes.rationale: sentence-transformers pulls torch (~2-3 GB), so matching/retrieval.py degrades to a hashed-ngram embedder when the package or cached model is absent: the system still runs with weaker dense recall instead of failing to start.

nodes.label: Optional LLM Provider Configuration
nodes.rationale: The LLM path is OFF by default and needs no package: Ollama is called over plain HTTP with stdlib urllib, so only python-dotenv is required to read .env config.

nodes.label: Per-Agent Model Overrides
nodes.rationale: CAVECREW_*_MODEL env vars patch only the model: line of installed agent frontmatter so the prompt body keeps receiving upstream updates; only plugin installs have local files to patch.

nodes.label: Cavecrew Subagent Presets
nodes.rationale: Same jobs as the vanilla Explore/edit/review agents, but the tool-result returned to the main thread is compressed; pick cavecrew when you want the finding in 1/3 the tokens, vanilla when you want prose.

nodes.label: cavecrew-investigator
nodes.rationale: Read-only locator returning path:line citations with backticked symbols so the main thread can grep the result mechanically.

nodes.label: cavecrew-builder
nodes.rationale: Hard-refuses 3+ file scope with a terminal first token so a mis-sized delegation fails fast instead of burning a turn on a half-done refactor.

nodes.label: cavecrew-reviewer
nodes.rationale: Returns findings only, sorted file then line ascending, with no architecture opinions; deep rationale is the vanilla Code Reviewer's job.

nodes.label: Subagent Output Contracts
nodes.rationale: Fixed shapes (path:line-first citations, terminal first tokens, severity-sorted findings) let the main thread parse results mechanically instead of re-reading prose.

nodes.label: Main-Context Token Budget
nodes.rationale: Subagent tool results are injected into main context verbatim, so a 2k-token prose Explore costs 2k of budget every delegation; across ~20 delegations the compressed contract is the difference between context exhaustion and finishing the task.

nodes.label: Caveman Mode (README)
nodes.rationale: Explicitly publishes no aggregate reduction or quality-equivalence claim: results depend on model and workload.

nodes.label: Caveman Compressed Response Mode
nodes.rationale: Compression is style-only and must never grow output: invented abbreviations and causal arrows are rejected because the tokenizer splits them the same as the full word, buying zero tokens while costing decode clarity. Negations, numbers and units are never dropped.

nodes.label: Caveman Intensity Levels
nodes.rationale: lite / full / ultra plus three wenyan variants; full is the default and a level persists until changed or session end.

nodes.label: Wenyan Classical Chinese Modes
nodes.rationale: Classical characters are confined to wenyan levels; swapping in a classical char at a non-wenyan level would shrink characters, not tokens, and break the user's language.

nodes.label: Auto-Clarity Rule
nodes.rationale: Compression is dropped for security warnings, irreversible-action confirmations, ambiguous multi-step sequences, and repeated questions, because a misread instruction costs far more than the tokens saved. Caveman resumes after the clear part.

nodes.label: User Language Preservation
nodes.rationale: Compress the style, not the language: article-dropping applies only to article languages, and particle/postposition markers carry case and are grammar rather than filler.

nodes.label: Caveman Persistence Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Anything persisted outside the chat (code, comments, commits, docs, issues, memory files, third-party messages) goes out in normal prose because other humans read it; /caveman-compress is the one exemption.

nodes.label: Caveman Commit Message Skill
nodes.rationale: Emits the message only and never stages, commits, or amends, keeping generation separate from the irreversible git action.

nodes.label: Conventional Commits Format
nodes.rationale: Subject carries type/scope/imperative summary under 50 chars (hard cap 72); the body exists only for the non-obvious why, because the diff already states the what. No AI attribution unless the user's own rule requires a trailer.

nodes.label: Mandatory Commit Body Cases
nodes.rationale: Breaking changes, security fixes, data migrations and reverts always get a body because future debuggers need context that cannot be compressed into a subject line.

nodes.label: caveman-compress (README)
nodes.rationale: CLAUDE.md loads on every session start, so a 1,000-token memory file costs 1,000 input tokens per session; the measured ~46% reduction over five fixtures passed structural validation only and does not establish semantic or task-quality equivalence.

nodes.label: Out-of-Tree Original Backup
nodes.rationale: The .original.md backup lives under $XDG_DATA_HOME or %LOCALAPPDATA% rather than beside the source so skill auto-loaders do not ingest the uncompressed copy a second time.

nodes.label: Compress Validate-Retry Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Only compression and a targeted cherry-picked fix spend tokens; size checks, cross-session locking, type detection and validation are local Python, and a failed validation patches the broken parts instead of recompressing.

nodes.label: Snyk High Risk Rating Explanation
nodes.rationale: Static analysis flags subprocess plus file I/O; the subprocess uses a fixed argument list with no shell interpolation and content passed via stdin, reads and writes stay confined to the target file and backup dir, and files over 500KB are rejected before any API call.

nodes.label: API Key or CLI Auth Fallback
nodes.rationale: With ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set the Anthropic Python SDK is used directly; without it the skill shells out to the claude CLI and reuses the user's existing desktop authentication, so the feature never hard-depends on a key.

nodes.label: Caveman Compress Skill
nodes.rationale: Compresses natural-language memory files in place to cut repeated input tokens, keeping a readable backup so the human still edits an uncompressed source; code and config extensions are never touched and mixed files get prose-only compression.

nodes.label: Read-Only Preserved Regions
nodes.rationale: Code blocks, inline code, URLs, file paths, commands, env vars, headings, dates and version numbers are copied byte-exact because a silent mutation inside them is unrecoverable and invisible to the reader; when unsure whether something is code or prose, leave it unchanged.

nodes.label: Caveman Workflow Discovery Skill
nodes.rationale: Operator-invoked and idempotent: it walks entry points rather than imports, proposes a labeling table, and only edits after the user agrees, because a telemetry observation never selects a callsite or authorizes an edit.

nodes.label: Workflow Label
nodes.rationale: One workflow is one job a human would name, so labels go on callers rather than a shared llm helper; slugs are lowercase [a-z0-9_-] and effectively permanent because renaming splits spend history.

nodes.label: x-cave-workflow Header
nodes.rationale: Rides in the same defaultHeaders block that already carries x-cave-api-key; the gateway rejects an invalid slug with 400 cave_invalid_request_header.

nodes.label: unlabeled-workflow Bucket
nodes.rationale: All unlabeled gateway traffic collapses into one bucket, which is the failure the labeling pass exists to remove; traffic not routed through the gateway cannot be labeled at all and is listed as not wired.

nodes.label: Caveman Evidence Review Skill
nodes.rationale: Read-only operator role: conclusions come from current Caveman data rather than repository guesses, it never starts/approves/cancels/rolls back an experiment, and an empty result is evidence of no current signal, not zero cost or zero risk.

nodes.label: Separated Evidence Buckets
nodes.rationale: Measured list-price cost, inferred daily headroom, verified ledger savings and evidence cost must never be added or relabeled, because blending them turns a catalog subtotal into an invoice or an experiment result into verified savings.

nodes.label: Bounded Trace Search and Cohort Comparison
nodes.rationale: Causality needs a suspect cohort against a control or an earlier bounded window; one expensive trace or an aggregate alone proves nothing, and prompt/completion payload retrieval stays off because metadata, spans, timing and token counts suffice.

nodes.label: Caveman Explore (FastContext)
nodes.rationale: A cheap haiku-pinned read-only locator whose file reads stay out of the solver's context; it fans out with parallel Glob/Grep/Read on the first turn and stops as soon as locations can be named, optimizing the solver's token budget.

nodes.label: Citation-Only Evidence Block
nodes.rationale: The reply is only path:START-END lines with a reason: no preamble or summary, only ranges actually read, and an honest 'no relevant locations found' instead of an invented range, because the solver consumes nothing else from the run.

nodes.label: Caveman Help Reference Card
nodes.rationale: One-shot display: it must not change mode, write flag files, or persist anything, so asking for help never mutates session state.

nodes.label: Default Mode Resolution Order
nodes.rationale: CAVEMAN_DEFAULT_MODE env var beats ~/.config/caveman/config.json, which beats the built-in full default; setting 'off' disables auto-activation while leaving manual /caveman available.

nodes.label: Analyzer/Editor Boundary
nodes.rationale: Binding split: the Go proxy analyzer only measures and writes a ranked plan, caveman learn apply stays read-only by materializing candidates, and this skill using the agent's own file tools is the ONLY thing that edits a user's config.

nodes.label: Embedded Skill Copy Drift Guard
nodes.rationale: The published CLI ships no sibling assets, so it embeds a byte-identical CAVEMAN_LEARN_SKILL_MD constant; a runtime test asserts the embedded copy equals the canonical SKILL.md, forcing both to change together.

nodes.label: caveman-learn skill (README)
nodes.rationale: Everything reported is inferred, never verified and never currency; each edit is consent-gated and reversible, and an offload that would leave the agent unable to recall the content is rejected.

nodes.label: Applied-Fix Outcome Ledger
nodes.rationale: caveman learn applied records sink, fix kind, application time and before-value so later scans return improved/unchanged/regressed/insufficient_data; the ledger itself never edits user or repository config.

nodes.label: Caveman Learn Editing Skill
nodes.rationale: The consent-gated half of caveman learn: it turns measured findings into edits one approved diff at a time, never claims an unmeasured saving, never makes the agent dumber, and never presents a window's spend as a run rate or as money saved.

nodes.label: Ranked Token Sinks
nodes.rationale: Classed as reducible, recurring_context, load_bearing or behavioral; cache_efficiency is a rate the others are priced at and must never be summed, and behavioral sinks such as session_outcomes and subagent_spend are correlational observations, never imperatives. load_bearing is never touched and appears only so the score stays honest.

nodes.label: cavemem_offload
nodes.rationale: Recurring context is stored raw in cavemem and recalled compactly, leaving a cheap pointer; the candidate carries only a locator whose content_sha256 must be re-verified against the real block locally, and a missing pointer or empty recall forces a revert because removing context without a working recall path is the failure the guard exists to block.

nodes.label: Net-Token-Negative Gate
nodes.rationale: An edit is kept only if a re-count shows after below before; it cannot be applied to skill distillation because that gate re-counts one file and cannot see a cost and a benefit that land in different places.

nodes.label: Skill Distillation Holdout
nodes.rationale: A distilled skill loads into the prefix every session but pays back only on matching sessions, the same shape as the punished dead_load sink, so it is graded by an on/off holdout of at least 5 sessions per arm rather than a re-count; insufficient_data means keep going, regressed means delete, and more tool errors on the on-arm outweigh a cheaper session.

nodes.label: Savings Evidence Rungs
nodes.rationale: deterministic_remeasure, controlled_holdout, counterfactual_replay and interrupted_time_series are never summed or blended into one headline; confounders are read out on wins, and changed_since or target_missing provenance disqualifies a row as a caveman result.

nodes.label: Caveman Experiment Management Skill
nodes.rationale: Every lifecycle change is treated as a production control action; the agent MCP surface is intentionally read-only because control-api does not yet enforce a complete transition table and evidence gate atomically.

nodes.label: Experiment Lifecycle Actions
nodes.rationale: start/approve/cancel/rollback each have preconditions; absence of a required guardrail field is 'evidence incomplete', not a pass, and unknown states or server errors fail closed with the exact cave_snake_code.

nodes.label: Mutation Execution Block
nodes.rationale: No lifecycle mutation is executed even after user approval, because an exact action:experiment_id string is agent-generatable and therefore not proof of human intent; success is never inferred from operator intent, only from a re-read of server state.

nodes.label: verified_savings Ledger
nodes.rationale: Experiment lift never becomes verified savings; only active real traffic plus provider-causal, provider-complete signed ledger evidence can.

nodes.label: Caveman Optimization Evaluation Skill
nodes.rationale: Observations are diagnostic input only, never savings estimates, recipes, or experiment eligibility; the operator must explicitly choose an observation before any callsite is inspected or changed, and stale .caveman/proposals files are untrusted historic context.

nodes.label: Report-Only Repository Profiles
nodes.rationale: context-window-profile, tool-catalog-profile, tool-output-size-profile and exploration-load-profile carry an immutable zero band and no actuation path, so they are never ranked by value nor turned into a claim about a particular callsite; the retired ids context-window-bloat, tool-catalog-utilization and verbose-tool-output are historical context only.

nodes.label: Paired Baseline/Candidate Eval
nodes.rationale: Both arms must run identical fixed inputs with the same quality check and the same token/byte/provider cost measure; without a fixture, a relevant quality check, or a common measurement method the work stops, since ordinary unit tests alone do not prove an optimization and a local paired result never establishes production savings.

nodes.label: caveman-review (README)
nodes.rationale: One line per finding as L<line>: <severity> <problem>. <fix>. with emoji severities; auto-clarity drops terse mode for CVE-class findings, architectural disagreements and onboarding contexts where the author needs the why. Output only: it never approves, requests changes, or runs linters.

hyperedges.label: Caveman Cloud Evidence and Lifecycle Pipeline
